Card Q&A.q: I have a [Jesmon GX]  that has  in play, while my opponent has a [BT10-042 Venusmon] in play. If I use this card and target my [Jesmon GX], can this card's effect activate [Jesmon GX]'s [When Digivolving] effects?

Effect: While you have a Digimon with [Royal Knight] in its traits in play, you may use this card without meeting its color requirements.
[Main] Unsuspend 1 of your Digimon. Then, if that Digimon is [Jesmon GX], activate 1 of its [When Digivolving] effects.
Security Effect: [Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.
